verdict.rationale: Seeing where a person sits in an automation and manually pulling or re-entering them is a fair question for a lifecycle automation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes automation structure (trigger, goals, exit criteria, workflows) and general automation management through MCP. Rule-based exit criteria are an adjacent feature, not a per-person view or a manual pull/re-entry control, so nothing documents the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see where any individual person sits inside an automation and pull or re-enter them without breaking the flow
